question: Across risk tolerance, compare the average net cash flow, average signed cash-flow amount, and average cash-flow count of investors.
sql_query:
WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net, AVG(amount) c_avg, COUNT(*) c_cnt FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id)
SELECT p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance,
       ROUND(AVG(cf.c_net),2) AS avg_net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(AVG(cf.c_avg),2) AS avg_cashflow_amount,
       ROUND(AVG(cf.c_cnt),2) AS avg_cashflow_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance
ORDER BY p.risk_tolerance;

question: Across time horizon, compare the average total holding value, average holding return and average holding gain (counting only holdings with a recorded cost and current value), and average dividends of investors.
sql_query:
WITH hold AS (SELECT o.investor_id, SUM(o.current_value) h_val, AVG(CASE WHEN o.cost > 0 AND o.current_value IS NOT NULL THEN o.returns_pct END) h_ret, SUM(CASE WHEN o.cost > 0 AND o.current_value IS NOT NULL THEN o.current_value - o.cost END) h_gain, SUM(o.dividends) h_div FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 o GROUP BY o.investor_id)
SELECT p.time_horizon AS time_horizon,
       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_val),2) AS avg_holding_value,
       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_ret),2) AS avg_holding_return,
       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_gain),2) AS avg_holding_gain,
       ROUND(AVG(ho.h_div),2) AS avg_dividends,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.investor_id) AS investor_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN hold ho ON ho.investor_id=p.investor_id
GROUP BY p.time_horizon
ORDER BY p.time_horizon;

Over investors that have all 4 components, min-max normalise each component to 0-1, and take 100 times their equal-weighted mean; break ties by investor_id.
sql_query:
WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     hold AS (SELECT o.investor_id, SUM(o.current_value-o.cost) h_gain FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 o WHERE o.cost > 0 AND o.current_value IS NOT NULL GROUP BY o.investor_id),
     alloc AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(total_investment) a_inv FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     scen AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(new_allocation_pct-current_allocation_pct) s_shift FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     per AS (SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
                 cf.c_net AS net_cash_flow,
                 ho.h_gain AS holding_gain,
                 al.a_inv AS sector_investment,
                 sc.s_shift AS scenario_shift
              FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
              LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN hold ho ON ho.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN alloc al ON al.investor_id=p.investor_id
              LEFT JOIN scen sc ON sc.investor_id=p.investor_id
              WHERE cf.c_net IS NOT NULL AND ho.h_gain IS NOT NULL AND al.a_inv IS NOT NULL AND sc.s_shift IS NOT NULL),
     b AS (SELECT MIN(net_cash_flow) mn_0, MAX(net_cash_flow) mx_0, MIN(holding_gain) mn_1, MAX(holding_gain) mx_1, MIN(sector_investment) mn_2, MAX(sector_investment) mx_2, MIN(scenario_shift) mn_3, MAX(scenario_shift) mx_3 FROM per)
SELECT per.investor_id, per.investor_name,
       ROUND(100.0*((net_cash_flow-b.mn_0)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_0-b.mn_0,0) + (holding_gain-b.mn_1)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_1-b.mn_1,0) + (sector_investment-b.mn_2)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_2-b.mn_2,0) + (scenario_shift-b.mn_3)*1.0/NULLIF(b.mx_3-b.mn_3,0))/4.0,2) AS composite_score,
       ROUND(per.net_cash_flow,2) AS net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(per.holding_gain,2) AS holding_gain,
       ROUND(per.sector_investment,2) AS sector_investment,
       ROUND(per.scenario_shift,2) AS scenario_shift
FROM per, b
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, per.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

question: Among investors with every component recorded, list the top 10 ranked by a composite score defined as net cash flow plus total rebalance amount plus total sector investment minus average goal shortfall (all components in INR); break ties by investor_id.
sql_query:
WITH cash AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) c_net FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     reb AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) r_amt FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     alloc AS (SELECT investor_id, SUM(total_investment) a_inv FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001 GROUP BY investor_id),
     goals AS (SELECT investor_id, AVG(shortfall) g_short FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id)
SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name,
       ROUND(cf.c_net + rb.r_amt + al.a_inv - g.g_short,2) AS composite_score,
       ROUND(cf.c_net,2) AS net_cash_flow,
       ROUND(rb.r_amt,2) AS rebalance_amount,
       ROUND(al.a_inv,2) AS sector_investment,
       ROUND(g.g_short,2) AS goal_shortfall
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
     LEFT JOIN cash cf ON cf.investor_id=p.investor_id
     LEFT JOIN reb rb ON rb.investor_id=p.investor_id
     LEFT JOIN alloc al ON al.investor_id=p.investor_id
     LEFT JOIN goals g ON g.investor_id=p.investor_id
WHERE cf.c_net IS NOT NULL AND rb.r_amt IS NOT NULL AND al.a_inv IS NOT NULL AND g.g_short IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, p.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

question: Which Conservative investors have an average goal progress below 30, an average holding return (counting only holdings with a recorded cost and current value) above 50, and a risk score above 50?
sql_query: WITH g AS (SELECT investor_id, ROUND(AVG(progress_pct),3) ap, ROUND(AVG(avg_sharpe_ratio),3) asr FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 GROUP BY investor_id), ho AS (SELECT o.investor_id, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN o.cost > 0 AND o.current_value IS NOT NULL THEN o.returns_pct END),3) aret, ROUND(AVG(o.dividends),3) adiv FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 o GROUP BY o.investor_id) SELECT p.investor_id, p.investor_name, g.ap, ho.aret, h.risk_score FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON h.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN g ON g.investor_id=p.investor_id JOIN ho ON ho.investor_id=p.investor_id WHERE p.risk_tolerance='Conservative' AND g.ap<30 AND ho.aret>50 AND h.risk_score>50 ORDER BY p.investor_id;
